result.summary: Several layout and content issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, the last popular-item card is cut off by the tab bar, and the category row is missing a clear overflow affordance.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in Fastest near you is truncated ('Trattoria Piccol') and the last category chip is cut off at the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow restaurant titles to wrap or scale, and add horizontal scroll plus a fade/peek so category chips are fully readable.

issues.description: The second Popular right now card is cropped by the bottom navigation, hiding the restaurant name, rating, and delivery info.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Category chips overflow the screen without a visible scroll hint besides a sliver of the next pill.
issues.suggestion: Show a partial next chip and/or a fade/arrow so users know they can swipe.
